description: Auth0 CLI: revealed client secrets, test tokens, deletions, user and role changes, and read commands.

rules.note: `--reveal` and `--reveal-secrets` print client secrets. `test token` prints an access token. `apps create` with a reveal option prints the new secret.
A delete removes an application, an API, a user, a role, an organization, an action, or a rule, with its settings.
Role assignments, user blocks, and organization members decide who can sign in and what they can do.

safe.note: Listings and details of applications, APIs, actions, roles, organizations, and tenants without revealed secrets, and log listings and tails.
